thread:
jamal: Ok team — last-minute panic. Who should I bench for tonight? My WR2 is a TD-or-bust pick. Also, we need a wings order for the watch party. Opinions?

sophia: bench the busty WR if you can get someone via FA. stats say he's 30% target share on 3rd downs only. also :raised_hands: for wings. what style? buffalo?

alex: If you want safe points, swap to the consistent slot guy. if desperate, ride the boom. Also fyi waiver priority is at 4 for you so quick claim might fail.

maria: I can handle wings if people chip in. ordering from SmokeyWings: https://smokeywings.example/order — they do a family pack with garlic-parm and honey-sriracha. Vote with emoji.

ben: garlic-parm all the way :heart_eyes: 

lina: Honey-sriracha for me, and bench the WR. take the floor target instead.

jamal: ok so consensus = bench WR, garlic-parm + honey-sriracha. lineup I'm considering:

```
QB: J. Allen
RB1: J. Cook
RB2: A. Ekeler
WR1: J. Jefferson
WR2: ? (bench candidate)
TE: T. Kelce
FLEX: D. Montgomery
```

alex: solid. if you can pick up D. Smith as WR2 do it. otherwise start the floor target.

sophia: also reminder-bot: "Team watch party tonight 7pm in the kitchen — please clean up after yourselves" :bell: (ops-bot pinged)

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Kitchen reserved 7:00 PM - 10:00 PM. Please take plates to sink.

maria: payment link: https://payments.example/chips — $6/pp. I'll order at 6:10 so final headcount then.

jamal: placing waiver now. if it fails, i'll ping here. wings — i'm in for $6.

ben: in. good luck getting that waiver! :crossed_fingers:

lina: in too. hope the wings survive the game.

jamal: waiver failed. benching the WR and rolling with the floor target. wings order placed. thanks y'all :taco: :rocket:
